name: Kingdom of Sweden

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 407,270 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 10,596,620. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted (personnel list): 14,850 active. Swedish Armed Forces article: 10,400 officers + 7,200 enlisted = 17,600 military employees, plus ~6-8,000 conscripts in training at any time; CIA Factbook 2025 ~25,000 (high). Mid ~20,000.

trainedReserves.note: IISS as quoted: 21,500 reserves. CIA Factbook adds ~21,000 Home Guard. High is an educated allowance for conscript-trained men placed in the wartime organisation (~90,000 total wartime strength is the commonly cited target).

supportPersonnel.note: Active 20,000 minus infantry P roles (5,000). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Cold War Sweden (wartime strength ~800,000 from ~8 million, ~10%) scaled down for today's smaller wartime organisation and equipment stocks.

count.note: Educated guess. Mechanized battalions of 3 brigades on CV90. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Swedish_Army)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): CV90, Strv 122.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional cadre plus conscripts (selective, motivated).

count.note: Educated guess. Ranger (Jaeger) battalions, amphibious corps, Gotland regiment. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swedish_Armed_Forces)

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Modern kit, Carl Gustaf, NLAW.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army): Selective conscription produces well-trained Jaeger units.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Strv 122 (Leopard 2A5 improved).

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional/conscript crews.

count.note: CV90 224 + Patria XA-360 112 + XA-180 34 + XA-203 148 + Bv410 167 = 685 (some CV90 donated to Ukraine).

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly below): CV90 among the best IFVs.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional/conscript.

count.note: Archer 26 (6x6) + 4 (8x8) = 30; high adds 40 Mjolner 120 mm CV90 mortar systems.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Archer is very modern but few.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional.

count.note: JAS 39C/D Gripen 71 + further C/D airframes 23 = 94; Gripen E entering service.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Gripen C/D with Meteor, Gripen E arriving.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Dispersed-basing doctrine well drilled.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly below): Modern.

count.note: RQ-7 Shadow 8 (UAV 03 Orkan); Skylark minis excluded.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional.

count.note: Visby/Goteborg corvettes 7 + patrol vessels 13 + mine countermeasure vessels 7 = 27; ~100 Combat Boat 90 assault craft excluded. No frigates.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Visby stealth corvettes.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army): Professional, archipelago warfare.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best) (slightly above): Stirling AIP, world-leading conventional subs.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly above): Professional.

count.note: Patriot (Lvsyst 103) 4 fire units + Lvkv 90 30 SPAAG (~6 per battery, ~5) + IRIS-T SLS/RBS 70/RBS 98 batteries ~3 = ~12.

quality.note: Rubric quality 0.75 (among the era's best): Patriot, IRIS-T.

training.note: Rubric training 0.75 (professional standing army) (slightly below): Professional.

commandQuality.note: Rubric commandQuality 0.75 (trained staff system, proven commanders) (slightly below): Trained staff, total-defence planning; no war since 1814.

cohesion.note: Rubric cohesion 0.75 (professional with strong unit identity) (slightly below): Professional cadre with motivated selective conscripts.

morale.note: Rubric morale 0.75 (motivated, recent victories) (slightly below): Motivated: strong societal will to defend (total defence culture), joined NATO 2024.

weapons.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Meteor, RBS 15, NLAW, Carl Gustaf M4, Archer.

armor.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Strv 122 with add-on armour; no APS.

ships.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Visby stealth corvettes, AIP submarines.

fortification.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Hardened underground facilities, civil defence.

logistics.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Dispersed road-base logistics.

communications.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: National secure networks, Link 16.

isr.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: GlobalEye AEW&C, signals intelligence (FRA).

air.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Gripen E (4.5 generation).

cyber.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Strong national cyber capability.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 537,478,053,528 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 10,596,620 = 50,722. Range +/-10%. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 671,427,924,457 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 537,478,053,528 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores. Corrected 2026-10-29: values x1.0376 because the rebase factor was an arithmetic error (0.8005); the right factor is 0.8306 (FRED GDPDEF, 2017=100: 2011 91.478 / 2021 110.130). Figures quoted above are before the correction.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 2.47% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 1.99% in 2024, 1.20% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 21.0% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Roughly self-sufficient in cereals and dairy; imports fruit/vegetables.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 5,338,595 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 6.091% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 65,039. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. BAE Hagglunds CV90 line (exports to several NATO states). (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_equipment_of_the_Swedish_Army)

aircraft_fighter.note: Educated guess. Saab Linkoping Gripen E.

roadKm.note: As quoted: 573,134 km incl. private and forest roads, 140,100 paved (2016).

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 9,714 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: UNCTAD 2025 as quoted: 1,142 thousand DWT under the Swedish flag; Swedish-owned tonnage under foreign flags is larger (educated high).

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2-1.3: forests, lakes and long distances, total-defence population support, harsh northern winter.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:SWE. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Swedish Army equipment list, active Swedish military aircraft list and active navy ship list; no frigates or destroyers, so ships_major is omitted. drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Home Guard (~21,000) excluded from active.
